title: Wanderburg Guide — How to Play for Beginners
description: Wanderburg beginner guide: core loop, castle controls, early priorities, FAQ, and how to grow your fortress in the first runs.

paragraphs: Wanderburg is a survivors-like roguelike where you drive a castle on wheels. You roll through the map, devour villages and smaller fortresses, then expand your stronghold with modular siege gear.
Official Steam copy frames the fantasy simply: castles hunt, villages flee, and only the biggest stronghold survives. Your castle does not just upgrade — it expands.
If you only want the vibe before reading tactics, watch the official reveal trailer or skim our Gameplay page, then come back here for the first-hour checklist.
Steam lists full support for mouse, keyboard, or controller. Community write-ups (GameStar, Bullet Haven) highlight inertia, drifting, and short nitro boosts — movement matters as much as firepower.
Tip from published guides: use drifts and circular paths so your frontal maw keeps eating while turrets keep shooting. Straight-line charging is easier to surround.
Controller players can start from Steam’s default layout. For handheld questions, see Steam Deck notes on this wiki — official Deck Verified status was not confirmed in our research pass.

Independent tips pages (Bullet Haven; German tip write-ups such as Apocanow) recommend prioritizing Carpenter / Zimmermann-style modules early for passive healing so you survive swarm pressure longer.
Focus boss fortresses when you can — published guides note that toppling rival castles is the main moment your fortress physically grows, not endless small grinds.
After you can stay alive for a few minutes, layer area-clear upgrades (community guides often favor on-hit explosion procs) before greedily stacking single-target only.
Steam describes a modular progression layer: unlock new modules, vehicles, artifacts, and captains between runs to open fresh strategies.
Treat Early Access balance as fluid. Prefer evergreen advice (survive longer, grow via bosses, unlock variety) over patch-specific numbers until the meta stabilizes.
When you are ready to specialize, jump to Best Build for an early package, Unlocks for meta categories, and Captains for what we can honestly say about that unlock lane.
Is Wanderburg free? The full Early Access game is a paid Steam title. A separate free Demo exists — details on the Demo page and Price page.
When did it launch? Steam listed Early Access for September 8, 2026. Confirm live dates on the store page; see Release Date for the EA window note (about 6–12 months estimated).
Is there multiplayer? Based on Steam and official marketing reviewed for this wiki, co-op is not advertised. See the Multiplayer FAQ so you are not misled by search suggestions.
Are there redeem codes? We found no official code system in store materials, so this wiki keeps codes as 暂无 instead of inventing strings.
New players: Demo → this Guide → Tips → Best Build.
